local PANEL = 1073742100
function OnStart()
  -- 1073742100 stays in a comment
  print("index 1073742100 in a string")
  local p = game.InstantiateClientUIControl(PANEL, script.object)
  game.ServerSignal("pick"):SendSignal()
  script:RegisterServerSignalHandler("picked", function(name, params) print("SIM got " .. tostring(params[1])) end)
end
